The '''Medical Corps''' (or '''MedCorps''') was one of the four branches of the [[Jedi Service Corps/Legends|Service Corps]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Along with the [[Educational Corps]], the MedCorps was one of the smallest parts of the larger Service Corps due to the already widespread teaching of the [[Force healing/Legends|healing arts]].

==Overview==
Life in the MedCorps teaches recruits that the life is fragile, and they quickly learn that people can become sick and die for no reason other than the will of the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]. For some, this can be hard to fathom, but internalizing it provides a valuable lesson for those who have had difficulty dealing with a personal loss early in life.<ref name="The Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Serving in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Halls of Healing]], the MedCorps maintained an infirmary there which rivaled the finest medical institutes in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Members of the MedCorps can be found at medical facilities throughout the galaxy , bestowing relief in times of crisis or instructing non-Force-using personnel in new methods to care for their patients. At the Temple, a dedicated high-speed transport system connected the infirmary with the [[Republic Central Medcenter/Legends|Republic Central Medcenter]] which was used to bring in non-Jedi with severe injuries or in need of specialized healing. Membership within the MedCorps included those Jedi who did not pass the [[Initiate Trials/Legends|Trials]] given to [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiates]] and were no longer eligible to walk the path of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]. Serving mainly as medical technicians or assistants to the [[Jedi healer/Legends|healers]] who roamed the Halls, these individuals were often deployed onto the battlefield during conflicts within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to serve as triage surgeons.<ref name="TJP" />

Following the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the MedCorps was dissolved and all its members were executed, or went into hiding. Decades later when the [[New Jedi Order|Order]] was rebuilt, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] opted not to reform the MedCorps or the Circle of Healers in favor of incorporating the ideas of both groups into the mainstream Jedi Order.<ref name="TJP" />
